seo.title: Pre-launch QA agents for websites | Superflow
seo.description: Paste your launch checklist. Agents check every page for noindex, staging links, missing tracking, and placeholders before the site goes live. You sign off.

hero.h1: Launch day. Nothing left on noindex.
hero.sub: Paste your launch checklist. Superflow builds agents from it. They check every page on desktop and phone the moment it's ready. You approve. Your client approves. Then it ships.
hero.clientLine: Your client taps Approve from the staging link the night before launch.

pack.name: Launch Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents for launch day. They run on every page of the staging site the moment it's ready.

agents.name: Noindex Check
agents.checks: Finds pages still blocked from search after launch.
agents.finding: noindex is still set on 14 pages. Google can't see the site.

agents.name: Staging Links
agents.checks: Finds links pointing at staging or preview URLs.
agents.finding: The header 'Book now' button links to staging.northwind.com.

agents.name: Tracking Check
agents.checks: Confirms analytics and tag manager fire on every page.
agents.finding: GA4 fires on every page except the thank-you page. Conversions won't count.

agents.name: Broken Links
agents.checks: Follows every link on every page and flags the ones that fail.

agents.name: Lorem Ipsum
agents.checks: Finds placeholder text left in the copy.
agents.finding: About page paragraph 2 is still Lorem ipsum.

agents.name: Placeholder Images
agents.checks: Finds stock placeholders and empty image slots.
agents.finding: Team page shows the theme's default headshot in 3 of 6 cards.

agents.name: OG Image
agents.checks: Checks every page has a share image that renders.
agents.finding: Share preview for /services shows a blank image.

agents.name: Mobile Overflow
agents.checks: Checks nothing wraps, clips or pushes the CTA down on phone.
agents.finding: Hero headline wraps to five lines on iPhone and pushes the CTA below the fold.

buildYourOwn.input: The favicon must be the client's, not the platform default.
buildYourOwn.finding: Site still shows the Webflow default favicon.

agentsCheck: No placeholder text or images remain.
youDecide: Whether the site is ready to show.
Which findings block launch and which can wait.
Whether the copy sounds like the client.

faq.q: Can the agents run on staging before we switch DNS?
faq.a: Yes. Point them at the staging URL. Agents check it the same way they check a live site, and findings pin to the same elements after launch.

faq.q: Should we run it again after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Run a rescan on the live domain. Only the pages that changed get checked, so a rescan costs a fraction of the first scan. The pricing page has the numbers.

faq.q: Can a deploy trigger the check?
faq.a: Yes. Add the Superflow webhook to your deploy step. Every publish runs the Launch Pack and posts findings before anyone has to remember to look.
